companyName: Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc. Common Stock
profile: Ascent Solar Technologies manufactures and sells flexible photovoltaic solar modules made with copper-indium-gallium-diselenide technology on plastic substrates. Its products provide power for specialized applications where rigid panels may not be suitable, including satellites, spacecraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, and other weight-sensitive markets. The company also designs finished products and works with partners on integrated solar solutions for vehicles and equipment.
